title: Topic 3.2: Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles

pages.lesson:
LESSON: DISINFECTING CLOTHING AND HOUSEHOLD ARTICLES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practises
Topic 3.2: Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles
2. Practise Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles in the examples.
2. Explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles
2. Practise Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
